The '''Shattered Moon''' was a moniker given to the lone [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tenupe]]. Red-hued, the moon had broken up into over fifty large fragments at a juncture in its history. During the [[Swarm War]] of [[36 ABY]], a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Moon Swarm|fleet]] secreted itself in the ruins of the moon in preparation to ambush [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] forces during the [[Battle of Tenupe]].
